nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The alley is narrower than it looked from the courtyard: one skip, two drains, and a wall of notices stapled over each other.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: At the far end there is a gate in a fence, and past the gate the ground goes on without a building on it.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You walked the alley between the flats. There is a gate at the end of it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nobody is in the alley. The gate is not locked.
